_comment: M1 hullhd: BOTF hero key -> Bridge Commander library Id (H:/StarhelmTools/bc-ships, read only). 'new' = class that drew the procedural fallback hull before; 'swap' = replaces an earlier model; 'rebuild' = same model, HD textures. tex = per-map pixel cap (default 2048). Only candidates whose own render looked like the class are used; classes with no candidate are not listed (see HULLHD-REPORT).

ship.rom.rdaran: troop ship (stand-in: boxy heavy Romulan hull)
ship.rom.bop_ent: unused hero rom.bop wired to the class
ship.rom.bop_tos: unused hero rom.bop wired to the class
ship.fer.bronta: scout. stand-in: only Ferengi hull on disk
ship.fer.ngort: destroyer. stand-in: only Ferengi hull on disk
ship.fer.goront: cruiser. stand-in: only Ferengi hull on disk
ship.fer.ooron: stand-in: only Ferengi hull on disk
ship.fer.tokorn: stand-in: only Ferengi hull on disk
ship.fer.tomax: colony ship; brown cargo hull, stand-in

ship.fed.nx: cleaner NX-01 refit skin, 2048 px native (chosen by side-by-side over the mottled NX)
ship.fed.nebula: 2048 px native, 10.1k tris, cleaner saucer than stock Nebula (1024, 23.8k)
ship.fed.defiant: 2048 native vs 1024; cleaner light hull than stock (dark, 54.6k)
ship.fed.intrepid: same Intrepid mesh at 2048 native vs 1024
ship.fed.centaur: same mesh as Centaur at 2048 native vs 1024
ship.rom.dderidex: 12.6k tris vs 10.0k, same 1024 native, cleaner teal skin
ship.fed.excelsior: in-engine retest: 4096 px native, 40.1k tris, detailed modern hull, lit correctly (the dark review render was an unlit-render artefact)

selection_note: 10 Nov 2026, Simon: pick the best-looking library variant per class; stats alone do not decide. Reviewed by the library review/iso renders (families: Fed, Klingon, Romulan, Cardassian, Ferengi, Dominion, Borg, Breen, Hirogen, Kazon). 'stock kept' = nothing better on disk. Rejected despite stats: ExcelsiorII (4096, dark grey, off-model colour), NeoConstitution (2048, dark, not TOS/refit look), JLSYOHVoyager (broken white texture), Peregrine__km and Peregrine (re-skinned Nebula), MirandaCVL/KTinga/KD7CVL/Galor/Keldon review renders dark so unverified in review (stock builds render fine in-engine), DJRaptor (Fed reskin), DS9FXBirdOfPrey (Fed mesh).
selection: native 2048, cleaner saucer; fixes Simon's wonky Nebula texture complaint at the source
only TOS-era hull; Enterprise/NeoConstitution are other classes or dark
DS9FXMiranda same mesh and tex; MirandaCVL review unverifiable
DS9FXGalaxy 7.5k tris is lower detail; Galaxy already 4096 HD
real Peregrine fighter; Peregrine__km is a Nebula reskin
B'rel, D7, K'T'Inga, K'Vort, Vor'cha, Negh'Var, Raptor, D4, D5
review of BirdOfPrey, K_TNG_*, KD7CVL, DS9FXBirdOfPrey, DJRaptor, LCRaptor, D7TOS: alternatives are lower-poly, same texture size, or other-faction meshes
all 1024 native; no higher-res Romulan hulls on disk
Galor, Keldon, Bakrus, C_TNG_*, CardFreighter, CardStation
Cardassian hulls top out at 1024 native
DomBC, DomBB, JLSBorg*, BreenBB, Hirogen, Kazon
DS9FX copies identical or lower; D_TNG_BATTLESHIP 2048 but 1.3k tris
in-engine retest 10 Nov: lit hull is detailed grey-blue, good; earlier rejection came from an unlit review render
retest: port-rim glare is specular from the uniform 0.55 metallic on a near-white hull. In-engine starboard frames: 0.55 strong glare, 0.25 about half, 0.05 nearly none. 0.08 shipped
NeoConstitution renders fine in-engine but is a different stylised hull, not the TOS Constitution
MirandaCVL renders fine in-engine but is a redesigned carrier variant, not a recognisable Miranda
KTingaCVL is the same mesh and tex as KTinga; KD7CVL is a K'Tinga hull (wrong class for D7); D7TOS equal tex, no gain

GalorCVL identical to Galor; DS9FXGalor/DS9FXKeldon and the BC-Aftermath Keldon are 0.8k-1.2k tris at 512 px: richer colour but far less geometry. Colour of the stock pair is washed out cream: open question
